# Amozecks Projects

> Amozecks Projects is a 100% Black-owned, NHBRC-registered contracting company serving public and private sector clients across South Africa for the past five years, with an exceptional service offering founded on honesty, reliability and quality. Slogan: "Do it right the first time." The company operates from Ballito/Durban (KwaZulu-Natal) and Kempton Park/Johannesburg (Gauteng).

## Services

- [Building](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): quality materials and professional builders, NHBRC-registered and compliant with the Housing Consumer Protection Measures Act.
- [Formwork](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): specialists in temporary or permanent moulds and support structures into which concrete is poured.
- [Renovations](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): home renovation, home remodelling, office renovation and office remodelling for projects big and small.
- [Plumbing](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): from blocked drains to geyser installation and leak detection.
- [Civil Works](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): civil works delivered by qualified engineers, technicians and workers with advanced equipment.
- [Property Development](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): specialised services to property developers, from land acquisition to agreements, conveyancing and litigation.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): 100% Black-owned contractor; BBBEE-compliant procurement; practical on-site training and local employment.
- [Projects](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): photographs of building sites, residential work and quality checks.
- [Instant Estimate](https://www.amozecksprojects.co.za/): indicative quote calculator that hands off to WhatsApp for firm quotes.
